title: Ines Varga — Raw Conceptual Sketch Portfolio

logo.specs: SVG; dark and light versions; square symbol for favicon. Until the owner’s own exists: the name set as a wordmark in the display face, and its first letter as the favicon — no invented symbol to throw away later. The favicon is a file (src/app/icon.svg, the letter as a path), never a generated icon route: one that fetches a font at build time breaks static hosting and builds without a network (Kelp Line)
logo.note: Wordmark: the name set in Caveat Brush (src/components/site/Header.tsx → Wordmark); favicon src/app/icon.svg is the letter I as a path. Replace with the owner’s logo.

typefaces.specs: Caveat Brush, Caveat, Winky Sans (Google Fonts)
typefaces.note: Caveat Brush, Caveat, Winky Sans via next/font/google (src/app/layout.tsx).

finalCopy.specs: Written in the recipe voice before layout; headlines ≤ 8 words
finalCopy.note: src/content/site.ts — every line marked PLACEHOLDER is invented (clients, quotes, dates, prices, studio town, email) and needs the real fact.

heroIllustration.specs: Layered SVG (3 depth layers if animated)
heroIllustration.note: Drawn as layered SVG in code (src/components/drawings/HeroMap.tsx: back pencil, mid ink, front marker). Stands in until a commissioned illustration replaces it.

spotIllustrations.note: Drawn as SVG strokes in code: footer landscape, walking route, margin-note arrows, mini map (About), place card (Contact), 404 sheet, desk note arrow.

featuredWork.usage: Home · Featured Work; Selected Work · Featured Work; Project · Featured Work
featuredWork.specs: 4 files · 1:1 · 2400×2400 — one strong picture of each project — the real work itself, never a mock-up (the same photo leads its project page)
featuredWork.note: Owner’s files are 3:2, shown cropped square.

projectPageCaseStudy.specs: 1 file per project · 21:9 · 2400×1029 — the project at its best, wide — the picture that opens its page
projectPageCaseStudy.note: Labelled placeholders at 2400×1029. Drop the real file in at the same path and set status to have in src/config/assets.ts.

projectPageGallery.specs: 8 files per project · 3:2 · 2400×1600 — the place and what it makes, as a set: wide views, close details, people at work — one light, one grade
projectPageGallery.note: Labelled placeholders at 2400×1600. Slots 3 and 6 of each project show the owner’s studio photos (process-path, process-supplies, process-palette, work-vintage-stack) until the project’s own set exists; only real photos open in the lightbox.

about.specs: 1 file · 4:3 · 2400×1800 — a real portrait of the person or the team, in their own place
about.note: Owner’s portrait is 3:4; cropped to 4:3/16:9 high on the face.

processPhotos.usage: About → How a map gets made; Home → the desk; project galleries
